title: NMES — Switching Weak Muscles Back On After Surgery

hook.en: After knee surgery the quadriceps can "switch off" even when the patient tries hard. Neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) is one of the few electrotherapy tools with good evidence. Learn when it helps, how to dose it and how to keep it safe.
hook.ur: Ghutne ki surgery ke baad quadriceps "band" ho sakta hai, chahe mareez poora zor lagaye. Neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) un chand electrotherapy tools mein se hai jin ka achha evidence hai. Seekhein yeh kab madad karta hai, iski dosage kaise rakhein aur isay mehfooz kaise rakhein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll explain arthrogenic muscle inhibition, choose patients who benefit from NMES, set strong, comfortable parameters and always pair stimulation with voluntary exercise.
goal.ur: End tak aap arthrogenic muscle inhibition samjhayenge, NMES se faida uthane wale mareez chunenge, taqatwar magar qabil-e-bardasht parameters set karenge aur stimulation ko hamesha apni marzi ki exercise ke saath jorenge.

text.en: After surgery or injury to a joint, swelling and pain signals from the joint **reduce the nervous system's drive** to the muscle around it. This is called **arthrogenic muscle inhibition (AMI)**: the muscle is not damaged, but the brain cannot fully switch it on. The quadriceps after knee replacement or ACL reconstruction is the classic example. **NMES** delivers electrical pulses through skin electrodes that make the muscle contract directly, so it can be strengthened while the voluntary drive is still poor.
text.ur: Joint ki surgery ya chot ke baad sujan aur joint se aane wale dard ke signal us ke aas paas ke muscle tak **nervous system ka hukm kam kar dete hain**. Isay **arthrogenic muscle inhibition (AMI)** kehte hain: muscle kharab nahi hota, magar dimagh isay poori tarah on nahi kar pata. Knee replacement ya ACL reconstruction ke baad quadriceps iski mashhoor misaal hai. **NMES** jild par lage electrodes se electrical pulses bhejta hai jo muscle ko seedha sikorte hain, is liye apni marzi ka hukm kamzor hone ke bawajood muscle ki taqat banai ja sakti hai.

text.en: AMI is like a **dimmer switch turned low** on the muscle's light. The bulb (muscle) works, but the switch (nervous drive) is down. NMES is like connecting the bulb **straight to the battery** for a while, so it keeps its strength until the switch is turned back up by exercise and reduced swelling.
text.ur: AMI muscle ki roshni ke **dimmer switch ko neeche kar dene** jaisa hai. Bulb (muscle) theek hai, magar switch (nervous drive) neeche hai. NMES thori der ke liye bulb ko **seedha battery se jorne** jaisa hai, taake us ki taqat bani rahe jab tak exercise aur kam sujan se switch wapas ooper na ho jaye.

steps.title: Screen first
steps.detail: Check for contraindications (pacemaker or other implanted device, broken or numb skin over the area, active cancer or a suspected clot in that limb) and explain the sensation. || Pehle screen karein

steps.title: Place the electrodes
steps.detail: Put large electrodes over the quadriceps, one near the motor point of vastus medialis and one over the upper lateral thigh. Support the knee in slight bend or full extension as the exercise needs. || Electrodes lagayein

steps.title: Set strong parameters
steps.detail: Common settings are a frequency of about 35 to 50 Hz, a pulse width of 200 to 400 microseconds, about 10 seconds on and 30 to 50 seconds off, raised to the highest intensity the patient can tolerate — a visible, strong contraction. || Taqatwar parameters set karein

steps.title: Add the patient's own effort
steps.detail: Ask the patient to tighten the muscle with every pulse (for example a quad set or straight-leg raise). About 10 to 15 contractions per session, most days, for several weeks, then wean as voluntary strength returns. || Mareez ki apni koshish jorein

question.en: Why does the quadriceps often "switch off" after knee surgery?
question.ur: Ghutne ki surgery ke baad quadriceps aksar "band" kyun ho jata hai?

text.en: Swelling and pain signals from the joint reduce the nervous drive to the muscle (arthrogenic muscle inhibition)
text.ur: Joint se sujan aur dard ke signal muscle tak nervous drive kam kar dete hain (arthrogenic muscle inhibition)

feedback.en: Yes — the muscle itself is not damaged; its activation is inhibited.
feedback.ur: Haan — muscle khud kharab nahi; us ka activation ruka hua hai.

text.en: The patient is not trying hard enough
text.ur: Mareez poori koshish nahi kar raha

feedback.en: AMI happens even with full effort.
feedback.ur: AMI poori koshish ke bawajood hota hai.

text.en: The surgeon cuts the femoral nerve
text.ur: Surgeon femoral nerve kaat deta hai

feedback.en: That does not happen in routine knee surgery.
feedback.ur: Routine knee surgery mein aisa nahi hota.

rows.en: Make the muscle contract to build strength
Strong but comfortable tingling, no contraction
rows.ur: Mazboot magar aaramdeh jhunjhunahat, contraction nahi

rows.en: About 35 to 50 Hz, with on/off cycles
rows.ur: Takreeban 35 se 50 Hz, on/off cycles ke saath
Takreeban 80 se 120 Hz (ya kam frequency ke bursts)

rows.en: Quadriceps strength early after knee replacement and ACL surgery
rows.ur: Knee replacement aur ACL surgery ke baad shuru mein quadriceps ki taqat

rows.en: Short-term pain relief; mixed long-term evidence
rows.ur: Thori muddat ka dard mein aaram; lambi muddat ka evidence mila jula

text.en: **Strong, short, with effort.** NMES only works when the contraction is strong enough, the session is focused, and the patient joins in with their own effort.
text.ur: **Mazboot, mukhtasir, koshish ke saath.** NMES tabhi kaam karta hai jab contraction kaafi mazboot ho, session focused ho, aur mareez apni koshish bhi shamil kare.

text.en: **Turning the intensity down to "comfortable tingling".** A weak, sensory-level current does not load the muscle, so it does not build strength. Coach the patient up to the strongest tolerable contraction over the first sessions.
text.ur: **Intensity ko "aaramdeh jhunjhunahat" tak kam kar dena.** Kamzor, sirf ehsaas wala current muscle par load nahi daalta, is liye taqat nahi banti. Pehle sessions mein mareez ko himmat dila kar sab se mazboot qabil-e-bardasht contraction tak le jayein.

question.en: Which patient is the best candidate for quadriceps NMES?
question.ur: Quadriceps NMES ke liye sab se behtar mareez kaun hai?

text.en: Two weeks after a knee replacement, with a quadriceps lag on straight-leg raise
text.ur: Knee replacement ke do hafte baad, straight-leg raise par quadriceps lag ke saath

feedback.en: Yes — early quadriceps weakness after knee surgery is where NMES has the best evidence.
feedback.ur: Haan — knee surgery ke baad shuruati quadriceps kamzori mein NMES ka sab se achha evidence hai.

text.en: A patient with a cardiac pacemaker and knee pain
text.ur: Cardiac pacemaker aur ghutne ke dard wala mareez

feedback.en: Implanted electronic devices are a contraindication without specialist advice.
feedback.ur: Implanted electronic devices specialist ki raye ke baghair contraindication hain.

text.en: A calf that is hot, swollen and tender after surgery
text.ur: Surgery ke baad garam, soojhi aur dardnak pindli

feedback.en: A suspected clot needs urgent medical review, not stimulation.
feedback.ur: Clot ke shak par fori medical jaanch chahiye, stimulation nahi.

question.en: What must accompany NMES in a good programme?
question.ur: Achhe programme mein NMES ke saath kya hona zaroori hai?

text.en: Voluntary strengthening exercises that progress as strength returns
text.ur: Apni marzi ki strengthening exercises jo taqat wapas aane par barhti jayein

feedback.en: Yes — NMES is a bridge, not a replacement for exercise.
feedback.ur: Haan — NMES pul hai, exercise ka badal nahi.

text.en: **Explain the feeling before you start.** A strong NMES contraction feels strange and can frighten people. Show it on yourself or on the other leg first, increase slowly, and tell the patient they are in control and can stop at any time. Record the settings and the intensity reached so the next session can progress.
text.ur: **Shuru karne se pehle ehsaas samjhayein.** Mazboot NMES contraction ajeeb lagta hai aur log dar sakte hain. Pehle apne aap par ya doosri taang par dikhayein, aahista barhayein, aur mareez ko batayein ke control unke paas hai aur woh kabhi bhi rok sakte hain. Settings aur pohanchi hui intensity likh lein taake agla session aage barh sake.

question.en: If AMI is caused by the joint, what else reduces it besides NMES?
question.ur: Agar AMI joint ki wajah se hai, to NMES ke ilawa aur kya isay kam karta hai?

answer.en: Reducing the joint's swelling and pain helps the muscle switch back on: compression, elevation, cryotherapy for comfort, and early, gentle movement. Studies also use exercise straight after cooling the knee, or after TENS, so the patient can contract harder during that window.
answer.ur: Joint ki sujan aur dard kam karne se muscle wapas on hota hai: compression, oonchai, aaram ke liye cryotherapy, aur jaldi, narm harkat. Studies mein knee ko thanda karne ya TENS ke foran baad exercise bhi istemal hoti hai, taake mareez us waqt zyada zor se contract kar sake.

beats.patient: A 66-year-old woman is 10 days after a total knee replacement. She cannot lift her straight leg without the knee bending (an extensor lag of 15 degrees), despite trying hard. Her wound is healing, there are no signs of a clot and she has no implanted devices.
beats.assessment: The picture fits arthrogenic muscle inhibition of the quadriceps after surgery.
beats.treatment: Start quadriceps NMES (strong, tolerable contractions, 10 to 15 per session, daily) with a quad set during each pulse, alongside her walking and knee-bending programme, and manage swelling.
beats.reassess: Over three weeks her lag closes, she lifts her leg straight and walks without a stick; NMES is stopped as her voluntary strength returns.

text.en: **Do not use NMES** with a pacemaker or other implanted electronic device (unless the specialist agrees), over the front of the neck or the chest, over a known or suspected clot, over active cancer, over broken, infected or numb skin, or over the abdomen or low back in pregnancy. **Stop and refer** for a hot, swollen calf, chest pain or breathlessness, or wound redness and discharge.
text.ur: **NMES istemal na karein** pacemaker ya kisi aur implanted electronic device ke saath (jab tak specialist ijazat na de), gardan ke saamne ya seene par, maloom ya mashkook clot par, active cancer par, tooti, infected ya sunn jild par, ya hamal mein pait ya neechli kamar par. **Rok kar refer karein** garam, soojhi pindli, seene mein dard ya saans phoolne, ya zakhm mein surkhi aur pani aane par.

summary.en: After joint surgery, swelling and pain inhibit the muscle's nervous drive (AMI); the quadriceps is the classic example.
summary.ur: Joint surgery ke baad sujan aur dard muscle ke nervous drive ko rok dete hain (AMI); quadriceps is ki mashhoor misaal hai.

summary.en: NMES works when the contraction is strong and tolerable: about 35 to 50 Hz, 200 to 400 microseconds, 10 seconds on with long rests, 10 to 15 contractions.
summary.ur: NMES tab kaam karta hai jab contraction mazboot aur qabil-e-bardasht ho: takreeban 35 se 50 Hz, 200 se 400 microsecond, 10 second on lambe aaram ke saath, 10 se 15 contractions.

summary.en: Always pair NMES with the patient's own effort and progressive exercise, and screen for implanted devices, clots and skin problems first.
summary.ur: NMES ko hamesha mareez ki apni koshish aur barhti exercise ke saath jorein, aur pehle implanted devices, clot aur jild ke masail ki screening karein.

back.en: Reduced nervous drive to a muscle caused by swelling and pain in the nearby joint.
back.ur: Qareebi joint ki sujan aur dard ki wajah se muscle tak kam nervous drive.

front.en: What NMES intensity is needed to build strength?
front.ur: Taqat banane ke liye NMES ki kitni intensity chahiye?

back.en: The strongest contraction the patient can tolerate — clearly visible, not just tingling.
back.ur: Sab se mazboot contraction jo mareez bardasht kar sake — saaf nazar aane wala, sirf jhunjhunahat nahi.

back.en: About 10 seconds on and 30 to 50 seconds off.
back.ur: Takreeban 10 second on aur 30 se 50 second off.

back.en: An implanted electronic device such as a pacemaker, and a known or suspected clot in the limb.
back.ur: Pacemaker jaisa implanted electronic device, aur taang mein maloom ya mashkook clot.

note.en: The other common electrotherapy, and how it differs.
note.ur: Doosri aam electrotherapy, aur yeh kaise mukhtalif hai.

note.en: The full rehab plan in which NMES is one part.
note.ur: Poora rehab plan jis mein NMES ek hissa hai.
